description: Readers planned but not available yet (E123). A planned reader is not in registry.json and is never offered for upload; asked to read, it refuses with its own sentence and reads nothing. A reader that lands on more than one type names the others in lands_on_also (E124). A slice that brings the reader deletes its row here and adds its registry entry in the same commit.

evidence.reason: Deferred on 22 Oct 2026 for three reasons. The real-data fixture planned for Petrel exports publishes its seismic as SEG-Y, not ZGY. The closure of pyzgy 0.1.1 includes segyio, which is LGPL-3.0, so the library can only be an optional extra outside the image (gate Z0). How a ZGY cube lands on seismic-volume is not decided (K5, gate Z2). A rights-recorded test cube is gate Z1.
